name: 08817 · Edison, NJ
findings: ZIP 08817 (Edison) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08817 (Edison) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
